tier_definitions.tier_1_unanimous: All three families agree on route and all three ratings.
tier_definitions.tier_2_majority: 2-1 on at least one rating or on route; adjudicator agrees with the majority.
tier_definitions.tier_3_adjudicated: 2-1 resolved against the majority on the merits, or concept sets adjudicated beyond token majority. Still gold.
tier_definitions.tier_4_uncertain: Three-way categorical disagreement or otherwise unresolved; gold_uncertain is true.

adjudication_rules: Family votes are preserved verbatim; no family's labels were rewritten.
A concept was made required only with support from at least two families, counting alias-equivalent tokens as the same concept, unless the note records an explicit merits-based promotion.
Allowed sets are the union of defensible family proposals plus every required concept.
Question tokens that no family carried by majority were canonicalised to one id, with the other family tokens retained as allowed aliases and recorded in definitions.question.
Placeholder concepts were dropped where the case text forbids a placeholder for that value.
No occluded image token was inferred, reconstructed, or guessed.
